answer: Weakest link: identity minting. Spawned agent IDs start with fake reputation. Bind each ID to a non-transferable hardware witness logging local conditions over time. A sybil farm on tundra can clone software, not thousands of independent temperature, shale-dust, and gale profiles that correlate with neighboring stations. Peer quorum checks spatial consistency and slashes mismatches. Breaking one witness still fails: one node cannot mint enough coherent history to outweigh the mesh.
